Culture Clips 4-mavzusining ikkinchi beti. Bosilgan bet raqami: 161.

Betda IKKINChI MATN — London Chinatown'i haqida (pushti fonda, chap tomonda).

To'rtta surat:
• C — osilgan qog'oz fonuslar: pushti-oq va sariq, naqshlangan
• D — Chinatown darvozasi: cherepitsali tom, xitoycha yozuvli qizil lavhalar va 'Chinatown' yozuvi
• E — olomon orasida sherlar raqsi: katta rangli sher niqobi, tutun, ko'p odam
• F — qizil o'ramlar (petarda pachkalari), ustida yorliqlar, yonida binafsha tayoqchalar

⚠ 160-betdagi 1b, 2a, 2b va 2d mashqlarining bir qismi aynan shu betdagi matn va suratlarga tayanadi.

⚠ Sariq bilan ta'kidlangan so'zlar (2d mashqi uchun): cheap, feature.

⚠ FAKT TEKShIRUVI: London Chinatown'i Gerrard Street atrofida — to'g'ri; u yerda mashinalar uchun yopiq piyoda zonasi bor — to'g'ri; Xitoy Yangi yilida bolalarga qizil pakatlarda pul berish an'anasi — to'g'ri.

⚠ HALOL IZOH: matnda 'oriental entrance' iborasi ishlatilgan. 'oriental' — eski atama; hozir 'Chinese' yoki 'East Asian' deyiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: READING TEXT 2 - LONDON: London's Chinatown is in the Gerrard Street area in the city centre.
exercises.instructionUz: 2-MATN — LONDON: London Chinatown'i shahar markazidagi Gerrard Street atrofida joylashgan.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKINChI MATN — LONDON ChINATOWN'i.


TO'LIQ MATN:

  'London's Chinatown is in the Gerrard
   Street area in the city centre. The
   Chinese Gate, which is a beautiful
   oriental entrance to Chinatown, is
   green and red and people see it as a
   SYMBOL of the success of the area.
   There is also a pavilion and no cars
   are allowed in the area. The streets
   are full of Chinese restaurants, food
   stores and specialist shops. Although
   it is called Chinatown, these
   BUSINESSES are from all over the Far
   East, including Thailand, Indonesia,
   Japan and Hong Kong. The area has
   become a MAJOR tourist attraction and
   part of London's culture.

   Britain's Chinese community celebrate
   Chinese New Year in style. London's
   Chinatown is DECORATED with lanterns
   and flags and the sound of noisy
   firecrackers fills the air. The whole
   area becomes a huge market with STALLS
   selling everything from CHEAP souvenirs
   to ANTIQUE Chinese vases. As in New
   York and all over the world, the lion
   dance is the main FEATURE of the
   celebration. However, there are many
   other special Chinese traditions. For
   example, children receive gifts of
   money in red packets with symbols on
   them to bring good luck.'


TARJIMASI:

  'London Chinatown'i shahar markazidagi
   Gerrard Street atrofida joylashgan. Xitoy
   darvozasi — Chinatown'ga olib kiruvchi
   go'zal sharq uslubidagi kirish joyi;
   u yashil va qizil rangda va odamlar uni
   hududning muvaffaqiyati ramzi deb
   bilishadi. Bu yerda pavilyon ham bor va
   hududga mashinalar kirishi taqiqlangan.
   Ko'chalar xitoy restoranlari, oziq-ovqat
   do'konlari va maxsus do'konlarga to'la.
   Garchi u Chinatown deb atalsa-da, bu
   korxonalar butun Uzoq Sharqdan — jumladan
   Tailand, Indoneziya, Yaponiya va
   Gonkongdan. Bu hudud yirik sayyohlik
   markaziga va London madaniyatining bir
   qismiga aylangan.

   Britaniyaning xitoy jamoasi Xitoy Yangi
   yilini dabdaba bilan nishonlaydi. London
   Chinatown'i fonus va bayroqlar bilan
   bezatiladi, havoni shovqinli petardalar
   ovozi to'ldiradi. Butun hudud ulkan
   bozorga aylanadi: rastalarda arzon
   esdaliklardan tortib qadimiy xitoy
   guldonlarigacha hamma narsa sotiladi.
   Nyu-Yorkdagi va butun dunyodagi kabi,
   sherlar raqsi bayramning asosiy qismi
   hisoblanadi. Biroq boshqa ko'plab maxsus
   xitoy an'analari ham bor. Masalan, bolalar
   omad keltirsin deb, ustida ramzlar bo'lgan
   qizil pakatlarda pul sovg'a olishadi.'


⚠⚠ 'WHICH' BILAN IZOH:

  'The Chinese Gate, WHICH IS a beautiful
   oriental entrance to Chinatown, is
   green and red...'

  ⚠ Ikki vergul orasidagi qism — IZOH
  (darvoza nima ekanini tushuntiradi).

  ⚠ EGA: 'The Chinese Gate'
     KESIM: 'is green and red'
  Izohni olib tashlasak ham gap to'liq
  qoladi.

  ⚠ 141 va 157-betlarda VERGUL bilan izoh
  bor edi; bu yerda 'WHICH' qo'shilgan.

  ⚠ 'which' — NARSA uchun;
     'who' — ODAM uchun.


⚠ 'ALTHOUGH' — GARChI:

  'ALTHOUGH it is called Chinatown, these
   businesses are from all over the Far
   East.'
     = Garchi u Chinatown deb atalsa-da,
       bu korxonalar butun Uzoq Sharqdan.

  ⚠ 'although' = 'though' = garchi
  ⚠ Gap boshida ham, o'rtasida ham
  kelishi mumkin.

  ⚠ DIQQAT: 'although' bilan 'but' BIRGA
  ishlatilmaydi!
     'Although it is small, it is nice.' ✓
     'Although it is small, BUT it is
      nice.' ✗


⚠ 'THE FAR EAST' — UZOQ ShARQ:

  Xitoy, Yaponiya, Koreya, Tailand,
  Indoneziya va boshqa Sharqiy/Janubi-
  Sharqiy Osiyo mamlakatlari.

  ⚠ 'the Middle East' = Yaqin Sharq
     (Turkiya, Eron, arab mamlakatlari)

  ⚠ Ikkalasi ham 'THE' bilan keladi.

  ⚠ Bu nomlar Yevropa nuqtai nazaridan
  berilgan — 'uzoq' va 'yaqin' Yevropaga
  nisbatan.


⚠ 'CELEBRATE' — KO'PLIK FE'L:

  'Britain's Chinese community CELEBRATE
   Chinese New Year.'

  ⚠ 'a community' — birlik ot, lekin
  Britaniya ingliz tilida ODAMLAR GURUHI
  bo'lsa KO'PLIK fe'l ishlatilishi mumkin.

  ⚠ Amerika ingliz tilida esa BIRLIK:
  'the community CELEBRATES'.

  ⚠ Shu kabi so'zlar: family, team,
  government, police.


⚠ QALIN HARFLI SO'ZLAR (2c mashqi uchun):

  symbol
     = ramz
     ⚠ 'a symbol OF' — 'of' bilan

  businesses
     = korxonalar, tijorat joylari
     ⚠ 'business' → 'businessES'
       ('-ss' → '-es')

  major
     = yirik, asosiy
     ⚠ zid ma'nosi: 'minor' (kichik)

  decorated
     = bezatilgan
     ⚠ 'to decorate' dan; majhul nisbat

  stalls
     = rastalar (bozordagi)
     ⚠ 'a stall' — bozordagi kichik
       sotuv joyi

  antique
     = qadimiy, antikvar
     ⚠ O'qilishi: [an-TIK] — 'que' = 'k'
     ⚠ 'old' dan farqi: 'antique' —
       QIMMATLI, yig'iladigan eski buyum


⚠ QIZIL PAKAT AN'ANASI:

  'children receive gifts of money in RED
   PACKETS with symbols on them to bring
   good luck'

  ⚠ Xitoy an'anasida QIZIL rang omad va
  baxt ramzi.

  ⚠ Pakatdagi pul miqdori ham muhim:
  ba'zi sonlar omadli (8), ba'zilari
  omadsiz (4) hisoblanadi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an entrance  = kirish joyi
  a symbol     = ramz
  success      = muvaffaqiyat
  a pavilion   = pavilyon
  to allow     = ruxsat bermoq
  a business   = korxona; tijorat
  the Far East = Uzoq Sharq
  major        = yirik, asosiy
  minor        = kichik
  in style     = dabdaba bilan
  a flag       = bayroq
  a stall      = rasta
  a souvenir   = esdalik sovg'a
  antique      = qadimiy, antikvar
  a vase       = guldon
  a feature    = asosiy qism
  however      = biroq
  a packet     = pakat, o'ram
  a gift       = sovg'a

exercises.instructionEn: 2  b) Read the texts again and underline the sentences/phrases which best match each picture.
exercises.instructionUz: 2  b) Matnlarni yana o'qing va har bir rasmga eng mos keladigan gap yoki iborani tagiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ HAR RASMGA MOS KELADIGAN GAPNI
MATNDAN TOPISh.

  ⚠ Bu — o'qish mahoratining muhim qismi:
  rasm va matnni bog'lash.


JAVOBLAR:

  A (ajdaho o'ymasi)
     → 'shops decorated with oriental
        CARVINGS and images'
     (yoki: 'the amazing DRAGON and lion
      dances')

  B (xitoy taomi)
     → 'hundreds of Chinese restaurants
        where you can try delicious
        oriental DISHES'

  C (fonuslar)
     → 'London's Chinatown is decorated
        with LANTERNS and flags'

  D (Xitoy darvozasi)
     → 'The CHINESE GATE ... is green and
        red'

  E (sherlar raqsi)
     → 'the LION DANCE is the main feature
        of the celebration'
     (yoki: 'watching the amazing dragon
      and LION DANCES')

  F (petardalar)
     → 'the sound of noisy FIRECRACKERS
        fills the air'


⚠ IKKI RASM UChUN IKKI MATNDAN HAM
  JAVOB TOPILADI:

  A va E — ikkala matnda ham uchraydi.

  ⚠ Sher raqsi ikkala shaharda ham bor —
  matnning o'zi buni aytadi:
  'AS IN NEW YORK and all over the world'.


⚠ QAYSI MATNDAN — QAYSI RASM:

  NYU-YORK matni (160-bet):
     A (o'yma), B (taom)

  LONDON matni (161-bet):
     C (fonus), D (darvoza), F (petarda)

  IKKALASI:
     E (sher raqsi)


⚠ 'TO UNDERLINE' = TAGIGA ChIZMOQ:

  'under' + 'line' = ost + chiziq

  ⚠ Shu qatordagilar:
     to underline  = tagiga chizmoq
     to highlight  = bo'yab belgilamoq
     to circle     = doira ichiga olmoq
     to tick (✓)   = belgilamoq
     to cross out  = o'chirib tashlamoq

exercises.instructionEn: 2  c) Use your dictionary to explain the words in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: 2  c) Lug'atdan foydalanib qalin harfli so'zlarni tushuntiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ QALIN HARFLI SO'ZLAR IKKI BETGA
TARQALGAN.


160-BETDA (Nyu-York matni):

  based
     = joylashgan
     'to be based in' = ... da joylashgan
     ⚠ 'a base' (asos, baza) dan

  oriental
     = sharqona
     ⚠ ESKI ATAMA — hozir 'Asian' yoki
       'East Asian' deyiladi

  winding
     = egri-bugri, buralgan
     ⚠ [WAYN-ding] — 'wind' (shamol,
       [wind]) bilan adashtirmang!

  comes to life
     = jonlanadi
     ⚠ so'zma-so'z: 'hayotga keladi'

  crowded
     = gavjum, odamga to'la
     ⚠ 'a crowd' (olomon) dan

  incredible
     = hayratlanarli
     ⚠ 'in-' + 'credible' (ishonarli)
     ⚠ so'zma-so'z: 'ishonib bo'lmaydigan'


161-BETDA (London matni):

  symbol
     = ramz, belgi
     ⚠ 'a symbol OF' — 'of' bilan

  businesses
     = korxonalar, tijorat joylari
     ⚠ 'business' → 'businessES'
     ⚠ O'qilishi: [BIZ-nis] — 'u' JIM!

  major
     = yirik, asosiy
     ⚠ zid ma'nosi: 'minor' (kichik,
       arzimas)

  decorated
     = bezatilgan
     ⚠ 'to decorate' → 'decoration'
       (bezak)

  stalls
     = rastalar
     ⚠ bozordagi kichik sotuv joyi
     ⚠ 'a stall' teatrda — parter o'rindig'i
       (boshqa ma'no)

  antique
     = qadimiy, antikvar
     ⚠ [an-TIK] — 'que' = 'k'
     ⚠ 'old' dan farqi: QIMMATLI,
       yig'iladigan eski buyum


⚠ LUG'ATDAN QANDAY FOYDALANISh:

  1) So'zning TURINI aniqlang:
     OT (n.), FE'L (v.), SIFAT (adj.)

  2) MATNDAGI ma'nosini tanlang —
     lug'atda bir necha ma'no bo'lishi
     mumkin.

     ⚠ Masalan 'a stall':
        1) bozordagi rasta ← bu yerda shu
        2) teatrdagi o'rindiq
        3) dvigatel to'xtashi

  3) MISOL GAPGA qarang — ma'nosi
     aniqroq bo'ladi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a dictionary = lug'at
  to explain   = tushuntirmoq
  in bold      = qalin harflar bilan
  a base       = asos, baza
  a decoration = bezak
  minor        = kichik, arzimas

points.en: based  =  located; having its main place somewhere
points.noteUz:

is BASED in New York City's Chinatown'.

⚠ 'a base' = asos, baza.

points.en: winding  =  with a lot of bends and turns
points.noteUz:
Matnda: 'walking along the WINDING streets'.

⚠⚠ O'QILISHI MUHIM:
  'winding' [WAYN-ding] = egri-bugri
  'wind' [wind] = SHAMOL

Bir xil yoziladi, BOSHQACHA o'qiladi!

Matnda: 'The streets are CROWDED with
people'.

⚠ 'a crowd' (olomon) → 'crowded' (gavjum).

⚠ 'crowded WITH' — 'with' bilan.

points.en: incredible  =  so good or surprising that it is hard to believe
points.noteUz:
Matnda: 'admiring the INCREDIBLE costumes'.

⚠ 'in-' (inkor) + 'credible' (ishonarli)
= 'ishonib bo'lmaydigan'.

⚠ 'amazing' bilan ma'nodosh — 2d mashqiga
qarang.

points.en: symbol  =  a thing that represents an idea

Matnda: 'people see it as a SYMBOL of the
success of the area'.

⚠ 'a symbol OF' — 'of' bilan.

⚠ 153-betdagi bo'lim muqovasida ham
'a symbol' so'zi bor edi.

points.en: businesses  =  shops, restaurants and other companies
points.noteUz:
Matnda: 'these BUSINESSES are from all over
the Far East'.

⚠ 'business' → 'businessES' ('-ss' → '-es').

⚠⚠ O'QILISHI: [BIZ-nis] — o'rtadagi 'i'
JIM! Uch harf emas, ikki bo'g'in.

points.en: major  =  very important or large  (opposite: minor)
points.noteUz:
Matnda: 'The area has become a MAJOR tourist
attraction'.

⚠ 'a major road' = katta yo'l;
'a minor problem' = arzimas muammo.

Matnda: 'a huge market with STALLS selling
everything'.

⚠ Lug'atda bir necha ma'no bor:
  1) bozordagi rasta ← BU YERDA SHU
  2) teatrdagi o'rindiq
  3) dvigatel to'xtashi

⚠ MATNGA qarab to'g'ri ma'noni tanlang.

Matnda: 'ANTIQUE Chinese vases'.

tovushi (fransuzcha yozilish).

⚠ 'old' dan FARQI: 'antique' — shunchaki
eski emas, QIMMATLI va yig'iladigan buyum.

Stanley Park, where there are beaches

groups.ruleUz: ⚠ GURUH OTLARI — BrE KO'PLIK, AmE BIRLIK

patterns.exampleEn: The Chinese Gate, which is a beautiful entrance to Chinatown, is green and red.
patterns.exampleUz: Xitoy darvozasi — Chinatown'ga go'zal kirish joyi — yashil va qizil rangda.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'which' — NARSA uchun; ikkala tomondan
vergul qo'yiladi.

patterns.exampleEn: Although it is called Chinatown, these businesses are from all over the Far East.
patterns.exampleUz: Garchi u Chinatown deb atalsa-da, bu korxonalar butun Uzoq Sharqdan.

patterns.exampleEn: London's Chinatown is decorated with lanterns and flags.
patterns.exampleUz: London Chinatown'i fonus va bayroqlar bilan bezatiladi.

patterns.exampleEn: ... stalls selling everything from cheap souvenirs to antique Chinese vases.
patterns.exampleUz: ... arzon esdaliklardan tortib qadimiy guldonlargacha hamma narsa sotiladigan rastalar.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'FROM ... TO ...' — chegara ko'rsatadi
(eng arzondan eng qimmatgacha).

patterns.formula: People see [nima] as a symbol of [nima].
patterns.exampleEn: People see it as a symbol of the success of the area.
patterns.exampleUz: Odamlar uni hudud muvaffaqiyati ramzi deb bilishadi.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'to see sth AS' = ... deb bilmoq;
'a symbol OF' — 'of' bilan.
